name: direction-aware-hover

frames.best_why: The office card is darkened with its Forest and Nature caption fully visible.

tagline: Photo cards that nudge and reveal a caption based on your entry side.
summary: Square image cards on a black page. Entering one from a side shifts the photo and its caption a little in opposite directions, darkens the picture and fades in a white label at the bottom-left.
appearance: Three square rounded image cards on black: a black-and-white swirl of contour lines, a bright office interior and a sky full of clouds. Each sits flat at rest, and a hovered one carries a dark veil with a small white label at its bottom-left.
behaviour: Entering a card from above, below, left or right nudges the image and the overlay text a few pixels in opposite directions, fades in a dark veil and reveals the label. Leaving reverses it.
demo_content: A swirl, an office and a cloudy sky, labelled Mountains, Forest and Ocean.
search_phrases: image card that reveals text on hover
photo reacts to which side cursor enters
gallery cards that darken on hover
text appears when hovering a photo
use_when: A gallery of people or destinations where captions should stay hidden until someone points at a card.
avoid_when: Touch screens: the caption and dark veil appear on hover only.
customise: Pass imageUrl plus overlay content as children; imageClassName, childrenClassName and className tune styling, while the nudge distances are fixed.
weight_why: A few image cards with short transform and opacity transitions; no loop.

a11y.note: Captions appear only on mouse hover, so keyboard and touch users never see them; alt text is just the word image.

issues: Captions are hidden on touch and keyboard, with no focus handling.
Demo images do not match their labels: a swirl is Mountains, an office Forest, a sky Ocean.
The directional nudge is only a few pixels; frames 1 and 6 look identical.
polish_why: Tidy cards and a subtle directional nudge; captions are invisible without a mouse.
title: Direction Aware Hover
